programme.desc: The habitat is celebrating “Sloth Day” in honor of its newest arrival: cool, chill, Lucia the sloth, who just arrived from Costa Rica! Realizing the error of his unwelcoming ways, Melman and the gang must try to win Lucia back and bring her back to the habitat before Kate (and the rest of the city) notices she’s gone!

programme.title: The Mother Flip (S1)
programme.desc: Rebecca and Kristy get a lead on a house in the Oak Hill neighbourhood of Austin. The kitchen and main bath are a hodgepodge of basic builder-grade finishes and the layout of the house is confusing.

programme.title: Dr. Pimple Popper: Breaking Out (S2)
programme.desc: Dr. Lee’s occupational therapist arrives to help re-train her body post-stroke. Medical patient Justin arrives with a body-covering, angry rash that is creating a wedge between him and his girlfriend.

programme.title: Rachael Ray In Tuscany
programme.desc: Rachael teaches how to prepare rabbit ragu, a traditional Tuscan recipe that combines ground rabbit, vegetables, wine and more to make a thick sauce served over long pasta.

programme.title: The Man in the Guesthouse
programme.desc: When a young couple finds someone to rent out their garage, they're happy to have an additional source of income. But soon they realise that their lodger may not be the dream tenant that they thought.

programme.title: MasterChef Australia (S18)
programme.desc: Curtis Stone kicks off Aussie Classics week, with a once-in-a-lifetime chance for the cooks to have their dish stocked in Coles, as they are challenged to whip up nostalgic Pie and Ice-cream flavours.

programme.title: MasterChef Australia (S18)
programme.desc: With Curtis Stone back in the kitchen, and the MasterChef contestants are challenged with cooking a dish that heroes pork to save their place in the competition.

programme.title: MasterChef Australia (S18)
programme.desc: It’s Aussie Classics Week, and there’s nothing Aussies love more than a great comeback story. Today, the previously eliminated contestants return for a chance to earn their place back in the competition.

programme.title: Rachael Ray's Meals In Minutes (S4)
programme.desc: Rachael brings a taste of Italy to New York with her stuffed tomatoes and olive-leaf pasta. The tomatoes are filled with an anchovy and breadcrumb mixture and the spinach pasta is tossed in a tomato sauce.

programme.desc: Aralin ang mga alamat, tula, at awit, at ang wastong paggamit ng mga pang-abay, pang-uri, at pandiwa.

programme.title: Grade 4 Math
programme.desc: Find out more about factors and multiples, addition and subtraction of fractions, improper fractions, mixed numbers, and decimals.

programme.title: Grade 4 English
programme.desc: Learn about personal pronouns, adjectives, verbs, context clues, and the different kinds of nouns.

programme.title: Grade 4 Araling Panlipunan
programme.desc: Suriin ang iba’t ibang gawaing pangkabuhayan batay sa heograpiya, oportunidad, at hamong kaakibat nito tungo sa likas kayang pag-unlad.

programme.title: Grade 4 Science
programme.desc: Discover how the major internal organs keep the body healthy. Learn about how animals and plants adapt to land or water, and their life cycles that can be affected by nature, as well as how living things interact with the environment.

programme.title: Preschool | Eccd
programme.desc: Learn and appreciate the Creator and the Creations, Communication, Cooperation, Relationship, Sense of Purpose

programme.title: Kindergarten
programme.desc: Learn about the concept of a family, school, and community, as well as letter names, sounds, and different vocabularies about the environment.

programme.title: Grade 1 Language
programme.desc: Matuto tungkol sa pabula at alamat at ang pagkasunod-sunod ng mga pangyayari nito. Alamin rin ang wastong paggamit ng magagalang na pananalita, pangngalan, malalaki at maliliit na letra, pati na rin ang pagbasa at pagbilang ng mga pantig.

programme.title: Grade 1 Math
programme.desc: Learn how to add and subtract whole numbers up to 100 including money.

programme.title: Grade 1 Reading & Literacy
programme.desc: Identify what are action words and describing words, and know how to follow and give directions involving one to two steps.

programme.title: Grade 1 Makabansa
programme.desc: Matutong pahalagahan at unawain ang pamilya at mga kasapi nito kabilang ang mga bahaging ginagampanan ng bawat isa.

programme.title: Grade 2 Filipino
programme.desc: Alamin ang mga elemento at bahagi ng kuwento, kabilang na ang pagpaghihinuha at pagbibigay ng susunod na pangyayari sa kuwento.

programme.title: Grade 2 Math
programme.desc: Learn how to subtract and multiply whole numbers up to 1000 including money.

programme.title: Grade 2 English
programme.desc: Identify different parts of a book and their uses, as well as learn about action words and words with short vowels.

programme.title: Grade 2 Araling Panlipunan
programme.desc: Matutong unawain ang kuwento ng pinagmulan ng sariling komunidad batay sa konsepto ng pagbabago at pagpapatuloy upang mapahalagahan ang kulturang nabuo ng komunidad.

programme.title: Grade 3 Filipino
programme.desc: Alamin kung paano gumamit ng magagalang na pananalita, salitang naglalarawan, at angkop na tanong. Alamin rin ang mga salitang magkatugma, pagkukumpara ng kuwento at pagbibigay ng wakas dito.

programme.title: Grade 3 Math
programme.desc: Learn multiplication and division of whole numbers including money.
